plugins.name: ruby-dev
plugins.description: Task-driven Ruby development toolkit: project scaffolding, data pipelines, multi-database (Ohm/Sequel/pgvector) modeling, GenAI components, RubyLLM client integration, typed LLM programs with dspy.rb, classical NLP toolkit, TUIs, desktop GUIs (glimmer-dsl-libui), diagnostics, refactoring, performance optimization, YARD documentation, and SIFT quality audits — routed by the `rubyist` orchestrator, which dispatches 5 phase subagents (specifier, implementer, cleaner, hardener, verifier) that load domain skills on demand.
